question: What do we do when we move very fast on our feet? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! When we want to move very quickly, we run using our strong legs! 🏃

question: How do we move forward slowly and safely? 🚶
explanation: Great job! Walking is a safe and steady way to move forward step by step! 🚶
hint: One foot goes in front of the other.

question: What is it called when we jump on just one leg? 🦘
explanation: Super! Hopping is a fun way to bounce up and down using only one leg! 🦘
hint: You lift one foot off the ground.

question: How do brave soldiers walk together? 🪖
explanation: Fantastic! Soldiers march by lifting their knees high and moving together! 🪖

question: What do we do before playing games to get our bodies ready? 🤸
explanation: Excellent! A warm-up wakes up our muscles so we can play safely! 🔥

question: How does a little green frog move? 🐸
explanation: Perfect! Frogs use both strong legs to jump really high in the air! 🐸

question: What helps us stand on one foot without falling? ⚖️
explanation: Awesome! Good balance keeps our body steady and stops us from falling over! ⚖️

question: What happens when we reach our hands high up to the clouds? ⛅
explanation: Great job! Reaching high is a wonderful stretch that makes us feel tall! 📏
hint: It makes your arms feel long.

question: What toy do we use to do skipping jumps? 🪢
explanation: Super! We use a skipping rope to swing and jump over with happy steps! 🪢
hint: You swing it over your head.

question: How does our body feel after a good warm-up? 🔥
explanation: Fantastic! Moving around makes our muscles warm and ready for fun! 🔥

question: What body part do we stretch when we bend to touch our toes? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Bending down to touch our toes gives our legs a really great stretch! 🦵

question: What happens inside when we take deep breaths? 🌬️
explanation: Great job! Taking slow, deep breaths helps our mind and body feel calm! 😌

question: How do we move our arms when we pretend to be a bird? 🦅
explanation: Super! Flapping our arms up and down looks just like beautiful bird wings! 🦅
hint: Up and down in the air.

question: Where should we put our arms to balance on a straight line? 👐
explanation: Fantastic! Putting our arms out wide like airplane wings helps us stay perfectly steady! 👐
hint: Like the wings of a plane.

question: What do we call a big, long jump over a muddy puddle? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! A leap is a giant step that takes us flying through the air! 🐆

question: How do we walk when we want to be very, very quiet? 🤫
explanation: Great job! Walking on our tiptoes makes us move quietly like a little mouse! 🩰

question: What sound do we make when we stomp our feet hard? 💥
explanation: Super! Stomping our feet makes a big, loud boom sound like a giant! 💥

question: What body part do we gently twist when we look side to side? 👀
explanation: Fantastic! We slowly turn our neck to see things on the left and right! 🦒

question: What part of our body do we roll around to loosen up? 🤷
explanation: Awesome! Rolling our shoulders in circles makes our upper body feel so relaxed! 🤷
hint: They connect your arms to your neck.

question: How do we move side to side without turning our body? 🦀
explanation: Great job! Sliding sideways is a fun way to move just like a little crab! ⛸️

question: What makes our heart beat faster and stronger? ❤️
explanation: Super! When we run and play hard, our strong heart pumps faster! ❤️

question: What shape do we make to stand tall and still in Yoga? 🌳
explanation: Fantastic! The Tree Pose helps us balance on one leg and stand tall and proud! 🌳
hint: It has green leaves and a trunk.

question: What do we need lots of to jump really high? ⚡
explanation: Awesome! Healthy food and rest give us the powerful energy we need to jump! ⚡

question: What two moves make up a happy skip? 🎵
explanation: Great job! Skipping is a fun pattern where we take a step and then a little hop! 🦘
hint: One foot goes forward, then bounces.

question: What keeps our feet safe and comfy when running outside? 👟
explanation: Super! Sneakers protect our feet and help us run fast without slipping! 👟

question: What do we do right after running to help our body calm down? 🧊
explanation: Fantastic! A cool-down with slow walks and stretches helps our heart relax! 🧊

question: How should we keep our back when we sit or stand up tall? 📏
explanation: Awesome! Keeping our back perfectly straight gives us strong and healthy posture! 📏

question: What body part do we bend when we pretend to sit in an invisible chair? 🪑
explanation: Great job! Bending our knees helps us squat down safely and build strong legs! 🦵
hint: The middle joint of your leg.

question: How do we move if we run fast but stay in the exact same spot? 📍
explanation: Super! Running in place is a great way to warm up without needing much room! 📍

question: What funny little things do we wiggle inside our shoes? 👣
explanation: Fantastic! Wiggling our toes is a fun little movement that makes our feet happy! 👣
hint: There are ten of them on your feet.

question: What healthy drink keeps us fresh while playing sports? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Drinking fresh water keeps our body hydrated and gives us super energy! 💧

question: How do we walk when we step backwards carefully? 🔙
explanation: Great job! Walking in reverse means carefully taking steps backward while looking out! 🔙

question: What body part is best for kicking a soft football? ⚽
explanation: Super! We use the side or top of our feet to give the ball a mighty kick! ⚽

question: What slow stretch helps relax a tired neck? 🦒
explanation: Fantastic! Slow neck rolls make our head feel light and take away the tightness! 🦒
hint: Moving your head in a circle.

question: What fun playground game uses hopping and jumping in drawn squares? 🟦
explanation: Awesome! Hopscotch is a classic game where we balance, hop, and jump through squares! 🟦
hint: You throw a stone into a numbered box.

question: How should our arms move when we do a strong march? ⬆️⬇️
explanation: Great job! Swinging our arms opposite to our legs makes marching look so powerful! ⬆️⬇️

question: What action with our arms helps us run much faster? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Super! Pumping our arms back and forth gives us extra speed to zoom ahead! 🏃‍♂️

question: What do we stretch nicely when we sit and point our toes down? 🩰
explanation: Fantastic! Pointing our toes stretches out our ankles and makes them super flexible! 🩰

question: What is the very best way to play games with our friends? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Working together with teamwork makes every game fair, safe, and super fun! 🤝

question: What fills up with air like a balloon when we breathe in deeply? 🎈
explanation: Great job! Our lungs act just like balloons, filling up with fresh, healthy air! 🎈

question: What part of our body makes big circles to spin a hula hoop? 💃
explanation: Super! Spinning our hips in big circles keeps the colorful hula hoop dancing around us! 💃

question: What must we always do the second we hear the teacher's whistle? 🛑
explanation: Fantastic! The whistle means we freeze right away to listen to important instructions! 🛑

question: What is it called when we walk with very big, heavy, loud steps? 🐘
explanation: Awesome! Stomping makes heavy sounds on the ground just like a big, friendly elephant! 🐘

question: What is the absolute best expression to have while playing outside? 😊
explanation: Great job! A big, happy smile shows that we are having a wonderful time playing! 😊

question: What do little practice steps help us do in sports? 🏆
explanation: Super! Taking little steps helps us learn new moves safely and easily! 🏆

question: What body part connects with the ground first when we take a step? 🌍
explanation: Fantastic! When we walk properly, our heel touches the ground softly first! 🌍
hint: The back part of your foot.

question: What do we stretch when we reach our arms far out to the sides? ↔️
explanation: Awesome! Opening our arms wide gives our chest a really healthy and deep stretch! ↔️
hint: The front part of your upper body.

question: What do we do to stop a flying ball from hitting the ground? ⚾
explanation: Great job! We use both of our hands together to gently catch the ball! ⚾

question: How do we feel inside when we stretch our whole body wide like a star? ✨
explanation: Super! Stretching like a big star makes our body feel open, free, and happy! 👐
hint: Like there is lots of space.

question: What do we use to safely watch where we are running? 👁️
explanation: Fantastic! We always keep our eyes open and looking forward so we run safely! 👁️
